parsedVerdict.reasoning: The six files form one domain model: three entities (Project, Task, User) and one repository port for each. Each repository imports only its own entity, and all three ports share the same save/getById/get* shape. The task-specific query variants appear only in TaskRepository, which fits Task's richer model. The only business rule in the unit, canMarkDone, appears once, in Task.ts, and no other file repeats it. I see no unrelated concern, duplicated invariant or bypassed abstraction. Project and User are structurally similar, but they are distinct aggregates, so that is not a duplicated rule.
